name: @aiti-ai/aiti-msg-nav
description: A scroll navigation bar on the right side of the message area — to earliest / to latest / previous / next user input, one-click direct access; long-press "to latest" keeps the screen awake

descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 消息区右侧的滚动导航条 —— 到最早 / 到最新 / 上一个 / 下一个用户输入，一键直达；长按「到最新」保持屏幕常亮

soul: 千楼万楼的聊天记录，电梯比楼梯好用。

soulI18n.en: For chat histories thousands of stories tall, the elevator beats the stairs.
